name: Jiang et al. Acceleration Structure
definition: An acceleration structure proposed by Jiang et al. [JRZ*16] that efficiently locates active cells for both direct and indirect visualization approaches, rendering active cells by ray marching.
summary: The Jiang et al. method is a hybrid object-order and image-order hierarchical structure that efficiently locates active cells for ray marching, differing from sibling methods by its resolution-dependent performance.
